content_en: It is through collaborative international frameworks that effective climate action can be achieved.

content_en: Never before has climate change posed such an existential threat to human civilization.

content_en: What distinguishes sustainable development from traditional economic growth is its holistic approach to environmental stewardship.
content_vi: Điều phân biệt phát triển bền vững với tăng trưởng kinh tế truyền thống là cách tiếp cận toàn diện đối với quản lý môi trường.

content_en: Scarcely had the environmental regulations been implemented when corporations began seeking loopholes.

content_en: It is the cumulative impact of microplastics that poses the greatest threat to marine ecosystems.

content_en: Seldom have conservationists encountered such complex challenges in biodiversity preservation.
